verses.1: The words that were spoken to Jeremias by Jehovah during the time of Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, king of Judah, are as follows:
verses.2: You went to the house of the charioteers, and you spoke to them. Then you brought them to the house of Jehovah. You placed them in one of the chambers there.
verses.3: And I will take Yaaznyah, son of Jeremiah, son of Habbasnyah, along with his brothers and all his sons, and also all the members of his household.
verses.4: And I will bring them into the house of Jehovah, into the room of Benjamin’s son, Jehudah. He is a man of God. This room is located above the room where the deeds of people are kept. He is the son of Shalom, who keeps the gates.
verses.5: And I gave them to the sons of the house of Rechavim. They were filled with wine and containers. I said to them, “Drink some wine.”
verses.6: And they said, “We will not drink wine, because Jonadab, son of Rechab, commanded us to say that we must not drink wine, neither you nor your children, forever.”
verses.7: And in the house, they shall not build it; they shall not sow seeds, nor tend the crops. And you shall not live there for many days, on the land where you dwell.
verses.8: And we heard the voice of Jehondab, son of Rekhav, our father. He commanded us not to drink wine in all our days. We are our children’s children.
verses.9: And I will not give them daughters as wives for us, nor fields, vineyards, or gardens. Nor will they have any seeds to plant.
verses.10: And they dwelt in tents, and they heard, and they became like all those whom our father Yonadab commanded.
verses.11: And it came to pass that Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, went into the land. And they said, “Let us go up and take Jerusalem from the hands of the enemy soldiers and from the hands of the army of Aram.” And they settled in Jerusalem.
verses.12: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to Jeremiah, “
verses.13: As the Lord, the army of Israel’s God, said: “Do not take any responsibility for hearing My words.” This is what the Lord says.
verses.14: I have set forth the words of Jehondab, son of Rekhav, who commanded his sons not to drink wine, and they have not done so until today. They heard the commands of their father, but I have spoken to you, and yet you have not listened to me.
verses.15: And I will send to you all my servants who are flying and flying around. I will say to them, “Return back from your evil paths. Repair the damage you have caused. Do not worship other gods instead of Me. Return to the land that I gave you, along with your ancestors. You did not listen to Me or obey My words.”
verses.16: For the sons of Jehozadab, son of Rekhavah, obeyed their father’s commands. But this people did not listen to me.
verses.17: Therefore, as the Lord God of armies and God of Israel says: “I will bring upon Judah and all those who live in Jerusalem all the evil that I have spoken about them. This is because I spoke to them, but they did not listen. I will call out to them, but they will not answer.”
verses.18: And to the house of the riders, Jeremiah said, “Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the commands of your father Jehudah, and kept all his laws, and did everything he commanded you to do.”
verses.19: Therefore, thus said Jehovah, the God of Israel: No one shall be honored by Yonadab, son of Rekav, who stands before me every day.
